question: Which city is Known as 'Venice of the East' Where the City Palace is located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udaipur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Udaipur** is known as the '**Venice of the East**'.
 
• The **City Palace** is located in **Udaipur**.
 
• Udaipur is famous for its lakes, palaces, and rich cultural heritage.
 
• The city is a popular tourist destination in the state of Rajasthan, India.
 
• It was founded by **Maharana Udai Singh II** in **1559**.
 
• Udaipur is also known as the 'City of Lakes' due to its sophisticated lake system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **City Palace** in Udaipur is a complex of palaces situated on the eastern banks of Lake Pichola.
 
• It was built over a period of nearly 400 years, with contributions from several rulers of the Mewar dynasty.
 
• The architecture of the City Palace is a fusion of Rajasthani and Mughal styles.
 
• Udaipur's Lake Palace, located on the **Jag Niwas Island in Lake Pichola**, is another iconic landmark of the city.
 
• The city hosts several cultural festivals, including the **Mewar Festival**, which showcases the region's cultural heritage.
 
• Udaipur is also an educational hub, with several universities and colleges offering a range of courses.
